items.title: Guided Onboarding Wizard
items.why: Our Q2 North Star is reducing time-to-value from 14 days to 3 days. 60% of churned users never completed setup.
items.what: Add a step-by-step setup wizard that guides new users through connecting a data source, inviting a teammate, and creating their first dashboard. Skippable and resumable.
acceptance_criteria: Wizard appears automatically on first login for new users
Users can skip at any step and return from help menu
Each milestone completable independently in any order
Completion confirmation with suggested next steps
Does not appear for existing users who completed setup
Functional on desktop and mobile browsers

items.title: API Rate Limit Docs
items.why: Developer support tickets about rate limits increased 40% last quarter, costing 10 hours/week.
items.what: Create comprehensive rate limit documentation with examples and troubleshooting guide.
acceptance_criteria: Every public endpoint page shows its rate limit and reset window
A developer who hits a 429 can find the retry guidance from the error message link
Code examples in 3 languages show backoff handling and run against the sandbox
Rate-limit support tickets drop by 25% within 60 days of publishing
